description: 西西里纳道夫 B90 — 长易位激活a1/d1车

intro.popup:
练习第8局
西西里纳道夫
长易位之后……
白方O-O-O激活两条线：
① a1车占a列
② d1车守d4
h4冲兵，向黑王翼发起进攻！
intro.popup_en:
Practice Game 8
Sicilian Najdorf
After queenside castling, White activates two lines: the rook on a1 can use the a-file, while the rook on d1 supports d4. Then h4 joins the pawn storm against Black's kingside.

outro.popup:
长易位激活车
① O-O-O长易位
② a1车可沿a列推进
③ d1车巩固中心控制
④ g4/h4冲兵攻击黑王翼
长易位 = 进攻位置 + 防御基础！
outro.popup_en: Queenside castling activates the rooks: the a1-rook can advance along the a-file, the d1-rook reinforces the center, and the g- and h-pawns can attack Black's king. Long castling provides both an attacking setup and a secure base.

moves.popup_en: e4 opens the game and occupies the center.
...c5 challenges the center with the Sicilian Defense.
Nf3 develops and prepares to occupy the center.
...d6 supports Black's central setup.
d4 challenges Black's central pawn.
...cxd4 captures the pawn on d4.
Nxd4 recaptures and brings a knight to the center.
...Nf6 develops and attacks e4.
Nc3 develops and reinforces the center.
...a6 is the characteristic Najdorf move, controlling b5 and preparing queenside expansion.
Be3 enters the English Attack setup, supporting a kingside pawn storm.
...e5 counterattacks in the center and gains space.
Nb3 retreats to avoid an exchange and keeps the knight available for later play.
...Be6 develops the bishop and supports Black's central control.
f3 reinforces White's center and supports a kingside pawn advance.
...Nbd7 develops another piece and supports the center.
Qd2 connects the pieces and prepares queenside castling.
...b5 begins Black's queenside counterattack.

moves.popup:
O-O-O！白方长易位！
王去c1，车到d1
现在a1车可以沿a列活动
d1车支撑中心d4
moves.popup_en: O-O-O! White castles long: the king moves to c1 and a rook reaches d1. The rook on a1 can now use the a-file, while the d1-rook supports the central pawn on d4.
...Nb6 develops the knight and contests key squares.

moves.popup:
g4！白方开始冲兵！
向黑王翼发动进攻
moves.popup_en: g4! White starts a pawn storm against Black's kingside.

moves.popup:
Rb8！黑方也开始反冲
车移到b8，准备b4攻击白王
moves.popup_en: ...Rb8! Black begins a counterattack, preparing ...b4 to open lines against White's king.

moves.popup:
h4！白方h兵继续推进
与g4配合，形成双兵进攻
长易位后：a1/d1双车激活
g4/h4冲兵攻击黑王——这就是长易位的力量！
moves.popup_en: h4! White advances the h-pawn to join g4 in a two-pawn attack. After long castling, both rooks are active and the g- and h-pawns drive toward Black's king.
